title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the famed 11/11/73 Winterland show – a Dark Star‑centric, high‑energy performance with solid second‑set flow despite noticeable pitch‑wow and occasional channel issues.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this November ’73 set, especially the 35‑minute Dark Star, the fiery China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider segue and a powerful Big River. The Gardner SBD source sounds generally clear and full, but reviewers note pitch drift, a slow wow and brief right‑channel loss that require correction. Overall the music outweighs the technical quirks, landing the show among the band’s top performances of the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give five‑star praise for the musical performance (strong Dark Star, A+ set ratings) while a detailed review points out pitch/wow flaws that lower the recording score; weighting 70% show + 30% recording yields ~4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix but suffers from consistent pitch errors (‑1% to ‑3% across tracks), a slow/long wow, occasional fast‑speed sections, and a brief right‑channel loss in the Eyes segment; listeners often apply pitch correction or mono fallback.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
And We Bid You Good Night
poor_songs: Sugar Magnolia / Uncle John's Band (off/sloppy toward end)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is a typical '73 mix—average with some rough spots—but the second set flips the script, delivering the show's high point early with Dark Star and maintaining momentum through strong mid‑set jams before closing on a heartfelt Good Night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jer takes a long leash on Big River and shines in the second half (Dark Star, China Doll), though later parts become a bit sloppy.
band_member_comments.Phil: The ‘monster Phil section’ in Dark Star is highlighted as a cool moment; his bass work throughout gets strong mentions.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby’s hoarse voice on Black‑Throated and his rhythmic additions on Half Step Mississippi are noted, with mixed feelings about early set performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's shuffling pocket is praised during Big River; overall drum work supports the high‑energy second set.
